verdict.rationale: The only evidence near this story is Custom Integrations: they create and map custom resources from unsupported tools, and Secureframe then handles normalization, mapping and testing (secureframe-docs-3, secureframe-docs-36). Built-in frameworks come with control mapping and automated tests (secureframe-docs-60), and the MCP server can manage controls, tests and frameworks (secureframe-docs-37). None of this explicitly shows user-defined frameworks or controls, so missing for 10: documented ability to create custom frameworks, custom controls with user-authored tests, custom evidence requirements alongside built-ins, and any hands-on corroboration.
